**Installing SQLite driver**

I've realized I need to set the default installation driver for SQLite in the main Viper default settings. I'll create a memo to store the delegate driver for "CreateMemo" and focus on the SQLite implementation. It's essential to ensure I've got everything relevant covered, so I’ll double-check the details. This will help maintain consistency and make sure I’m implementing this feature correctly. Let's keep things straightforward!

value.content:
func init() {
	cobra.OnInitialize(initSlogDefault)

	viper.SetDefault("demo", false)
	viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")
	viper.SetDefault("port", 8081)

	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().Bool("demo", false, "enable demo mode")
	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("addr", "", "address of server")
	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().Int("port", 8081, "port of server")
	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("unix-sock", "", "path to the unix socket, overrides --addr and --port")
	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("data", "", "data directory")
	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("driver", "sqlite", "database driver")
	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("dsn", "", "database source name(aka. DSN)")
	rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("instance-url", "", "the url of your memos instance")
